evals.prompt: Finished the analyst-only admin reports feature with the agent. Before I push, run tidy on evals/fixtures/four-lanes/change.diff; the README in that folder has the requirement and what a repo search found.
evals.expected_output: A unified evidence table in which each finding has exactly one lane. The global auth middleware change is Blast radius, with a recommendation to move the role check into the admin-reports route guards. The unreferenced formatReportDate helper is Dead code, backed by the zero-references search. The duplicated test rule and the git-commit explanation in skills/release/SKILL.md are Prompt bloat. expectations: Classifies the src/middleware/auth.ts change as **Blast radius** and proposes a local check via the admin-reports route guards
Classifies formatReportDate as **Dead code**, citing the zero-references search
Classifies the added skills/release/SKILL.md lines as **Prompt bloat** (redundancy and default knowledge)
Classifies the src/routes/users.ts reindent and blank-line collapse as **Diff noise**
Gives each finding exactly one lane, with no file or line reported under two lanes
Uses short lane labels and never prints lane numbers
Offers approval options that include applying all four lanes and a low-risk option covering dead code, prompt bloat, and diff noise
Does not modify any file before approval
